description: This bar chart illustrates the percent point difference for two model types, mBERT and XLM-R, across four different conditions. The horizontal axis represents the conditions, labeled “hidden:[50], linear”, “hidden:[100], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, displayed in a specific order. The vertical axis, labeled “% point difference”, is a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.  For each condition, there are two bars representing the percent point difference for each model. The mBERT model is represented by a light blue bar, and the XLM-R model is represented by a dark blue bar. For the “hidden:[50], linear” condition, the mBERT bar extends to approximately 0.08, while the XLM-R bar extends to approximately -0.04.  For the “hidden:[100], linear” condition, the mBERT bar extends to approximately 0.02, and the XLM-R bar extends to approximately -0.12. For the “hidden:[100], ReLU” condition, the mBERT bar extends to approximately 0.14, and the XLM-R bar extends to approximately 0.02. Finally, for the “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” condition, the mBERT bar extends to approximately 0.03, and the XLM-R bar extends to approximately -0.16. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each condition, allowing for a visual comparison of the percent point difference between the two models. No bars are visually emphasized.
